title: A Semester for the Prom
author: Coral Pemberton
blurb: Vesper Okafor, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
